name: Sample Child Health Plan

age_rules.text: Children from birth up to and including age 17 are eligible for cover as dependents of the principal member.
Dependents aged 18 to 24 remain eligible only if they are full-time students and financially dependent on the principal member.

benefits.name: Inpatient care
benefits.text: Inpatient care covers hospital admission, surgery and specialist fees up to the annual inpatient limit.

benefits.name: Maternity and newborn care
benefits.text: Newborn care is covered from birth if the baby is registered within 30 days.

benefits.name: Dental care
benefits.text: Dental care covers check-ups, fillings and extractions up to the annual dental limit.

benefits.name: Optical care
benefits.text: Optical care covers eye tests and one pair of spectacles per policy year.

waiting_periods.text: A 30-day waiting period applies to inpatient care for new members.
A 90-day waiting period applies to dental care.
A 90-day waiting period applies to optical care.

exclusions.text: Cosmetic dental procedures, including teeth whitening and veneers, are excluded.
Treatment arising from pre-existing conditions is excluded during the first 12 months of cover.
